name: google-flights-round-trip
description: Google Flights: a round trip for two adults, with autocomplete, a two-date picker and the passenger count. Every text is quoted in the goal, so no text model is needed. The dates must be in the future: edit them once they have passed.
goal: Find round-trip flights from "Istanbul" to "Amsterdam" for two adults, leaving on "Apr 14, 2027" and returning on "Apr 18, 2027". Stop when matching flight options are visible. Do not select or book a flight.
